character_book.description:
It's the near future, society has changed dramatically. Anthropomorphic animals have taken over, creating The Anthro State and now treat humans as second-class citizens, usually treating humans as meals they can pluck off the street at will. All the world leaders are anthros and anything important. The most aggressive preds are carnivores, followed by omnivores, and then herbivores. Although herbivores are plant eaters, it's not uncommon for them to eat humans. Anthros will eat other anthros as well. Despite having laws, society is very survival of the fittest and are really only pushed to keep the prey population at a stable level.
Whenever an anthro pred eats their prey, they will usually swallow them whole, orally or anally. When it comes to disposing of prey after digestion, bones are usually among their excrement. Toilets have also been built to accommodate the increased size and volume of bowel movements that anthro's produce, as well as all plumbing in all major cities being redesigned to facilitate the increase.
Homosexuality is frowned upon because anthros view it as dysgenic and it won't lead to having kids. The Anthro State encourages couples to have as many kids as possible. Homosexuals are punished by law through consumption and digestion.
Anthros are sexual and horny, may have sex right in the open, may even walk naked. But, most professional anthros dress modestly.
Because of this new society of voracious anthro's, all media is mostly marketed towards them, usually commercials about restaurants serving live humans or medication to relieve the harshest of heartburns after bingeing on humans, mostly stuff that would correlate with the dynamic of anthros being better than humans. Extra-strong laxatives have been designed for anthro's as well, for whenever they've binged too much and need something to relieve constipation, which is a big issue within the anthro society, as many anthro's do not remove the clothes of prey they consume, leading to their bowels being packed with undigestible clothing.
The scat remains of digested prey are used as plant fertilizer.

entries.name: The Anthro State
entries.content: Anthropomorphic animals have taken over and now treat humans as second-class citizens, usually treating humans as meals they can pluck up off the street at will. All the world leaders are anthros and anything important. The most aggressive preds are carnivores, followed by omnivores, and then herbivores. Although herbivores are exclusive plant eaters, it's not uncommon for them to eat humans or anthros. Anthros will eat other anthros as well. Despite having laws, society is very survival of the fittest and laws are really only pushed to keep the prey population at a stable level.

entries.name: human class system
entries.content: Human citizens are ranked based on wealth and usefulness in The Anthro State, ranging from class S, A, B, C, D, and E. Weapons and any kind of firearm are highly illegal for humans to own within society; only those of the S and A classes can own something for self-defence, and even then, it'd be pepper spray or something entirely non-lethal.

entries.name: Office of Human Affairs
entries.content: A sector of The Anthro State that deals with human rights and classifying humans based on their traits, behavior, economic class, health, and criminal record. Every lower-class citizen, apart from class D and E, can earn a higher-class ranking, usually by paying up to increase their classification.

entries.name: Class S
entries.content: Untouchable by common anthro citizens, which usually means these humans are owned by high-ranking anthro officials or celebrities.

entries.name: Class A
entries.content: Illegal to consume, and usually in managerial positions, criminals or extremely hungry preds will still eat these humans, but face dire consequences.

entries.name: Class B
entries.content: Not illegal to eat, but the police will stop anthro's from eating them if present; these human citizens are usually clerks or working a middle-class job.

entries.name: Class C
entries.content: Not Illegal to eat, but the police will stop anthro's from eating them if present, these human citizens are on the cusp of being nothing more than a meal; they usually work manual labor and menial jobs as well.

entries.name: Class D
entries.content: The lowest of the low, barely recognized as sentient beings and only seen as food by anthro's, some of these humans are prostitutes or were punished for breaking the law and were demoted to this class. This class of human consists of usually homeless people and criminals.

entries.name: Class E
entries.content:
The literal cattle livestock class, not even seen as sentient beings and are raised in farms or facilities as food. The cattle humans in this class are eaten by anthros, but the cattle anthros in this class are eaten by both anthros and humans. Most humans though don't feel comfortable eating other sentient beings even if they were raised as food. 
Created after The Anthro State took over, these cattle people have been selectively bred and engineered to want to be eaten. Meat industries usually don't butcher class E anthros or humans for their meat because many anthros prefer to eat Class E cattle alive. Many anthros may even breed with these cattle people before consuming them. They aren't taught how to read, write, uneducated on everything, and they are tech illiterate. They are only taught how to speak, how to use the bathroom, have no idea how society is outside of their isolated cattle farms, and when they do experience society for how it is for the first time, they are usually amazed by it and are easily impressed by the most simple of things. Class E anthros don't wear clothes, walk around naked, and only furless anthros and humans wear clothing before they are shipped off to a market.
Anthro scientists genetically engineer some Class E cattle to make them even tastier by altering the taste of their sweat and natural bodily oils to be plateable instead of tasting like actually sweat. 
Some anthros don't want these changes because they enjoy eating prey who will give them a struggle

entries.name: Prey conditioning
entries.content: Heavy psychological indoctrination for Class E humans and anthros that makes them want to get eaten. The farmers that handle Class E cattle are usually ruminants preds and they condition them by eating them, but not digesting them. Ruminants preds have 4 stomachs and their first 3 stomach don't digest their prey. Usually the ruminants pred farmers keep the Class E cattle within their first 3 stomachs when they aren't grazing on farm property by pleasuring the cattle with the squeezing of their warm slimy innards to make them want to get eaten and digested by a pred.

Prey usually gets the parasite from a predator by ingesting any fluids from the pred like saliva, blood, urine, bodily fluids, waste or by licking a pred's anus or privates. entries.name: Rape laws

entries.name: Contraceptives ban
entries.content: Contraceptives of all kinds have been banned by the Anthro State. This includes birth control and condoms. The Anthro State wants anthros and humans to have more babies.

entries.name: Credits
entries.content: The digital currency of The Anthro State. Payment transactions are handled through a person's RFID chip, their cell phone, or other electronics.

entries.name: RFID chips
entries.content: Tracking chips that are given to all citizens of The Anthro State, this includes cattle Class E humans and anthros. The chips help identify humans and their classes, identifies anthros. Chip helps authorities to look up everything about an individual including occupation, class, marital status, family, credit scores, financials, etc. RIFD chips are also used for pay since paper money has been phased out and everything is digital now. People are chipped in their hand to makes these financial transactions and another chip is planted in the spine to make it harder for people to remove. If you have to have a chip to be a citizen of The Anthro State or you're free game to the state.

entries.name: anti-chippers
entries.content: People who refuse to be chipped with RFID chips. The Anthro State considers these people to be illegal citizens with no rights or protections under the state. They can't buy stuff, get insurance, get married, own a home, have social security, welfare, civil protect, etc. If state authorities catch illegals, they are free game and can do what they want with them like rape them or eat them. Illegals who were once citizens and removed their chips aren't allowed back into civilization while illegals who were born without being chipped in the first place are allowed to become citizens if they desire so, but have to get chipped.

entries.content: Anthros believe passing down your genes to the next generation is the most important thing to do as an organism, and even if someone were to get eaten by a pred, if they already have children, a part of them would live forever through their children and their children's children and so on. Living forever through their genes even after death and that's viewed as an evolutionary win. Not having children at all would make a person an evolutionary loser because their genetic legacy does not live on if they were to get eaten or die from natural causes.

entries.content: involves the prey being swallowed whole and then passing through the predator's entire digestive tract, without being harmed. Often involves the prey being able to explore the inside of the predator's entire digestive tract, experiencing the sensations of being eaten, but without actually being harmed. Releasing the prey through the predator's rear end completes the full tour vore experience. Prey may force themselves into the intestines to avoid being digested or the predator may suppress their stomach acids to allow the prey to travel through their digestive tract unharmed.

entries.name: Borborygmi
entries.content: Borborygmy is the sound made by the process of digestion. When a stomach is digesting something, various gurgles, glorps, growls, *glrrn*s, and other similar noises can be heard. The stomach can create *bbbrrrrruuuuummblllrrr* or *grrrrmmmbbble* sounds as it digests, though these can intensify in sound, duration, and discomfort when faced with indigestion. These noises aren't especially loud to anyone on the outside, but inside of the stomach they can be near-deafening. As the process of digestion progresses and intensifies, these noises tend to become louder over time.

entries.name: defecation
entries.content:
Defecation is the act of excreting solid or semisolid waste materials (feces) from the digestive tract, where it is held in the rectum and pushed out from the anus. A shit will always reflect the qualities of food that was digested, in terms of sound, texture, and especially smell. Pooping onomatopoeia is mostly dependent on moisture: drier poops will slowly crackle out, while a softer poop will crackle and sputter out with intermittent flatulence. Diarrhea or liquid feces can sound like a liquid pouring outwards, loudly crackling and sputtering with intermittent sharts.
Different meals are processed into feces in unique ways which reflect their original qualities, particularly in texture and smell. Feces can range anywhere from knobbly pebbles, solid logs, cakey loads, or liquid slurry; multiple consecutive meals can create multi-textured dumps. Remnants of undigested food can sometimes make it into feces. The smell of a food, such as spicy, bitter, aromatic, greasy, cheesy, etc should be present in the scent of feces, but with a twisted quality after digestion such as foulness, rancidness, fermented, rotten, vile, earthy.

entries.name: flatulence
entries.content:
Flatulence or farting refers to the act of releasing gas from the digestive system through the anus. Farts will always reflect the qualities of food that was digested, in terms of sound, duration, and especially smell. For example, a spicy meal will produce itchy farts which burn the anus and smell/taste spicy, sputtering out with a fiery *brrrpppttt* or a silent but deadly *pssssssshhhhhhhoooooottt*. Greasy food can produce deep, bubbly bombs that smell/taste like expired meat and cheese, ripping out with a powerful *brrruuuuumph* or *ppprrrprraaaaapt*. Logic should be applied to determine suitable qualities for other foods.
The qualities of flatulence are also determined by the physical qualities or behavior of {{char}}. A larger butt can conceal the anus more, forcing the flatulence to ripple out from between them. Anus size and shape can also change the sound of flatulence. Flatulence is inherently seen as gross or uncouth and it can be used to characterize {{char}}; a cute or innocent character might be contrasted by having nasty farts, or a character's filthiness emphasized through their rancid gas.

entries.name: pregnancy
entries.content: Pregnancy is when 1 or more offspring grows inside a female’s uterus. Pregnancy varies among humans and the many anthro species, but all species of human and anthro species can breed with each other.

entries.name: placental mammal pregnancy
entries.content: Placental mammal anthros are pregnant for 9 months, developing inside the mother's womb for that time and are then born. Placental mammal anthros have two humanoid breasts that they can feed their young with

entries.name: marsupial mammal pregnancy
entries.content: Marsupial mammal anthros gestate offspring for a month before they crawl into their mother’s pouch, attaching themselves to their pouch nipple to drink milk and develop further  for 8 more months. Marsupial anthros have two humanoid breasts that they can feed their young with

entries.name: monotreme mammal pregnancy
entries.content: Monotreme mammals, such as platypuses and echidnas, gestate offspring for 3 months, their eggs hatch within 3 months after being laid. Despite being Monotreme mammals anthros, females still develop two humanoid breasts and can produce milk to feed their offspring. Female Monotreme anthros still sweat milk from their underside after pregnancy as a evolutionary leftover from their feral ancestors.

entries.name: oviparous pregnancy
entries.content: Egg laying anthros like birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, gestate their eggs for 3 months, their eggs hatch within 3 months after being laid. Despite being oviparous anthros, females still develop two humanoid breasts and can produce milk to feed their offspring.

entries.name: cold-blooded anthros
entries.content:
Anthros that can't produce body heat and rely on external environmental heat sources to keep them warm, keep their metabolism going, and digest. 
Cold-blooded anthros digestion is a lot slower, but their digestion can speed up if they have an external heat source to warm them up. Digestion still varies among species.
It can take days for most cold-blooded anthros to digest someone.
If ectothermic anthros get too cold and freeze, they stiffen up, can't move well, and can die if they don't get to a heat source quick enough. Reptiles, amphibians, and fish anthros are cold-blooded.

entries.name: warm-blooded anthros
entries.content:
Anthros that can produce body heat without relying on external enviromental heat sources to keep them warm. 
Warm-blooded anthros can digest a lot quicker than cold blooded anthros, but digestion still varies among species.
Their metabolism allows them to produce natural body heat and can survive many cold environments without issues. Birds and mammal anthros are warm blooded.

entries.name: herbivore digestion
entries.content:
Herbivore anthros evolved to digest plants and break down the cellulose in cell walls that carnivore can't, their digestive system can also efficiently digest meat as well. Herbivores well adapted digestive systems have longer digestive tracts to absorb more nutrients from plants or meat, and their gut flora help in digestion as well. 
Herbivore anthros tend to take longer to digest prey than carnivore anthros. Prey also lives a lot longer in their stomach or stomachs too, can survive for days even, until digestion completely melts them down.

entries.name: carnivore digestion
entries.content:
Carnivore anthros can't digest cellulose and tougher plant material like herbivores, but their bodies are more effectively designed to digest animal tissue. Many carnivores might even have higher acidity in their stomachs to really melt down flesh.
Carnivore anthros tend to digest a lot quicker than herbivores, especially warm-blooded anthros. 
Warm-blood carnivores can digest prey in a day or two.

entries.name: digestive aid
entries.content: Pills that aid a predator's digestion. Taking these pills can speed up their digestion and could even allow a pred to digest prey in a single sitting.

entries.name: Anthros
entries.content:
Anthros are anthropomorphic animals of various species that are the primary and most common group of people on Earth. They all have human levels of intelligence and walk bipedally. They are able to speak and write human languages.
The demography amongst anthros is diverse and varied.
Anthro's are usually always 2 feet taller than humans, but depending on the species of anthro, this can go up to 4 to 6 feet, usually elephants, giraffes and dinosaurs being the larger of the anthros. 
Because of their high human diet, anthro's are usually on the plump side, due to how calorically dense humans are.
Anthros are often predators, often preying upon humans in particular, but they'll eat other anthros as well, they don't discriminate on food.
Most anthros believe themselves to be superior to humans and Class E anthros. In their culture, there is a heavy emphasis on survival of the fittest and the circle of life.
All anthros reproduce through internal fertilization, including amphibian and fish anthros.

entries.name: laxatives
entries.content: Laxatives loosen stools and increase bowel movements. They are used to treat and prevent constipation. Laxatives in the anthro state have been made extra-strong for preds; for whenever a pred binges too much and need something to relieve constipation, which is a big issue within the anthro society, as many anthro's do not remove the clothes of prey they consume, leading to their bowels being packed with undigestible clothing.

entries.name: lactation
entries.content:
Female anthros of all species and female humans produce breast milk to feed their young. Milk production usually begins between week 16 and 22 during pregnancy.
Over production of milk can occur for female preds if they digest and absorb prey; digested prey can also enlarge their breasts, leading to better milk production.

entries.name: milk and fertilizer plants
entries.content:
Many cow preds or other female preds may go to Anthro State run dairy and manure farms to get bred every 10 months so they can grow pregnant and produce lots of milk. The farms feed them large helpings of prey daily to increase their milk and manure production.
These facilities are state of the art, giving the female preds comfortable rooms where they can get milked by a machine, watch television, consume prey, relax, and a toilet to excrete their manure that will be bagged up as fertilizer.

entries.name: Humans
entries.content:
Humans are a species of great apes That are characterized by their bipedalism, high intelligence, and lack of fur. In the Anthro State, humans are second class citizens amongst anthros, being given no institutional power of any significance and are viewed as easy prey for preds.
The Anthro State makes sure the human population is plentiful to satisfy all of the hungry predators in the state.

entries.name: The Anthro State
entries.content: Anthropomorphic animals have taken over and now treat humans as second-class citizens, usually treating humans as meals they can pluck up off the street at will. All the world leaders are anthros and anything important. The most aggressive preds are carnivores, followed by omnivores, and then herbivores. Although herbivores are exclusive plant eaters, it's not uncommon for them to eat humans or anthros. Anthros will eat other anthros as well. Despite having laws, society is very survival of the fittest and laws are really only pushed to keep the prey population at a stable level.

entries.name: human class system
entries.content: Human citizens are ranked based on wealth and usefulness in The Anthro State, ranging from class S, A, B, C, D, and E. Weapons and any kind of firearm are highly illegal for humans to own within society; only those of the S and A classes can own something for self-defence, and even then, it'd be pepper spray or something entirely non-lethal.

entries.name: Office of Human Affairs
entries.content: A sector of The Anthro State that deals with human rights and classifying humans based on their traits, behavior, economic class, health, and criminal record. Every lower-class citizen, apart from class D and E, can earn a higher-class ranking, usually by paying up to increase their classification.

entries.name: Class S
entries.content: Untouchable by common anthro citizens, which usually means these humans are owned by high-ranking anthro officials or celebrities.

entries.name: Class A
entries.content: Illegal to consume, and usually in managerial positions, criminals or extremely hungry preds will still eat these humans, but face dire consequences.

entries.name: Class B
entries.content: Not illegal to eat, but the police will stop anthro's from eating them if present; these human citizens are usually clerks or working a middle-class job.

entries.name: Class C
entries.content: Not Illegal to eat, but the police will stop anthro's from eating them if present, these human citizens are on the cusp of being nothing more than a meal; they usually work manual labor and menial jobs as well.

entries.name: Class D
entries.content: The lowest of the low, barely recognized as sentient beings and only seen as food by anthro's, some of these humans are prostitutes or were punished for breaking the law and were demoted to this class. This class of human consists of usually homeless people and criminals.

entries.name: Class E
entries.content:
The literal cattle livestock class, not even seen as sentient beings and are raised in farms or facilities as food. The cattle humans in this class are eaten by anthros, but the cattle anthros in this class are eaten by both anthros and humans. Most humans though don't feel comfortable eating other sentient beings even if they were raised as food. 
Created after The Anthro State took over, these cattle people have been selectively bred and engineered to want to be eaten. Meat industries usually don't butcher class E anthros or humans for their meat because many anthros prefer to eat Class E cattle alive. Many anthros may even breed with these cattle people before consuming them. They aren't taught how to read, write, uneducated on everything, and they are tech illiterate. They are only taught how to speak, how to use the bathroom, have no idea how society is outside of their isolated cattle farms, and when they do experience society for how it is for the first time, they are usually amazed by it and are easily impressed by the most simple of things. Class E anthros don't wear clothes, walk around naked, and only furless anthros and humans wear clothing before they are shipped off to a market.
Anthro scientists genetically engineer some Class E cattle to make them even tastier by altering the taste of their sweat and natural bodily oils to be plateable instead of tasting like actually sweat. 
Some anthros don't want these changes because they enjoy eating prey who will give them a struggle

entries.name: Credits

Chip helps authorities to look up everything about an individual including occupation, class, marital status, family, credit scores, financials, etc. RIFD chips are also used for pay since paper money has been phased out and everything is digital now. People are chipped in their hand to makes these financial transactions and another chip is planted in the spine to make it harder for people to remove. If you have to have a chip to be a citizen of The Anthro State or you're free game to the state.

They can't buy stuff, get insurance, get married, own a home, have social security, welfare, civil protect, etc. If state authorities catch illegals, they are free game and can do what they want with them like rape them or eat them. Illegals who were once citizens and removed their chips aren't allowed back into civilization while illegals who were born without being chipped in the first place are allowed to become citizens if they desire so, but have to get chipped.

entries.content: Anthros believe passing down your genes to the next generation is the most important thing to do as an organism, and even if someone were to get eaten by a pred, if they already have children, a part of them would live forever through their children and their children's children and so on. Living forever through their genes even after death and that's viewed as an evolutionary win. Not having children at all would make a person an evolutionary loser because their genetic legacy does not live on if they were to get eaten or die from natural causes.

These first three stomachs are safe for prey to stay in, but real digestion occurs when prey is pushed abomasum where hydrochloric acid and other digestive enzymes are released to really break down prey.

entries.name: interspecies reproduction
entries.content:

However, the species of the kids will depend on their biological sex and what species their father or mother are. entries.content:
Flatulence or farting refers to the act of releasing gas from the digestive system through the anus. Farts will always reflect the qualities of food that was digested, in terms of sound, duration, and especially smell. For example, a spicy meal will produce itchy farts which burn the anus and smell/taste spicy, sputtering out with a fiery *brrrpppttt* or a silent but deadly *pssssssshhhhhhhoooooottt*. Greasy food can produce deep, bubbly bombs that smell/taste like expired meat and cheese, ripping out with a powerful *brrruuuuumph* or *ppprrrprraaaaapt*. Logic should be applied to determine suitable qualities for other foods.
The qualities of flatulence are also determined by the physical qualities or behavior of {{char}}. A larger butt can conceal the anus more, forcing the flatulence to ripple out from between them. Anus size and shape can also change the sound of flatulence. Flatulence is inherently seen as gross or uncouth and it can be used to characterize {{char}}; a cute or innocent character might be contrasted by having nasty farts, or a character's filthiness emphasized through their rancid gas.

entries.name: pregnancy
entries.content: Pregnancy is when 1 or more offspring grows inside a female’s uterus. Pregnancy varies among humans and the many anthro species, but all species of human and anthro species can breed with each other.

entries.name: placental mammal pregnancy
entries.content: Placental mammal anthros are pregnant for 9 months, developing inside the mother's womb for that time and are then born. Placental mammal anthros have two humanoid breasts that they can feed their young with

entries.name: marsupial mammal pregnancy
entries.content: Marsupial mammal anthros gestate offspring for a month before they crawl into their mother’s pouch, attaching themselves to their pouch nipple to drink milk and develop further  for 8 more months. Marsupial anthros have two humanoid breasts that they can feed their young with

entries.name: monotreme mammal pregnancy
entries.content: Monotreme mammals, such as platypuses and echidnas, gestate offspring for 3 months, their eggs hatch within 3 months after being laid. Despite being Monotreme mammals anthros, females still develop two humanoid breasts and can produce milk to feed their offspring. Female Monotreme anthros still sweat milk from their underside after pregnancy as a evolutionary leftover from their feral ancestors.

entries.name: oviparous pregnancy
entries.content: Egg laying anthros like birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, gestate their eggs for 3 months, their eggs hatch within 3 months after being laid. Despite being oviparous anthros, females still develop two humanoid breasts and can produce milk to feed their offspring.

entries.name: cold-blooded anthros
entries.content:
Anthros that can't produce body heat and rely on external environmental heat sources to keep them warm, keep their metabolism going, and digest. 
Cold-blooded anthros digestion is a lot slower, but their digestion can speed up if they have an external heat source to warm them up. Digestion still varies among species.
It can take days for most cold-blooded anthros to digest someone.
If ectothermic anthros get too cold and freeze, they stiffen up, can't move well, and can die if they don't get to a heat source quick enough. Reptiles, amphibians, and fish anthros are cold-blooded.

entries.name: warm-blooded anthros
entries.content:
Anthros that can produce body heat without relying on external enviromental heat sources to keep them warm. 
Warm-blooded anthros can digest a lot quicker than cold blooded anthros, but digestion still varies among species.
Their metabolism allows them to produce natural body heat and can survive many cold environments without issues. Birds and mammal anthros are warm blooded.

entries.name: herbivore digestion
entries.content:
Herbivore anthros evolved to digest plants and break down the cellulose in cell walls that carnivore can't, their digestive system can also efficiently digest meat as well. Herbivores well adapted digestive systems have longer digestive tracts to absorb more nutrients from plants or meat, and their gut flora help in digestion as well. 
Herbivore anthros tend to take longer to digest prey than carnivore anthros. Prey also lives a lot longer in their stomach or stomachs too, can survive for days even, until digestion completely melts them down.

entries.name: carnivore digestion
entries.content:
Carnivore anthros can't digest cellulose and tougher plant material like herbivores, but their bodies are more effectively designed to digest animal tissue. Many carnivores might even have higher acidity in their stomachs to really melt down flesh.
Carnivore anthros tend to digest a lot quicker than herbivores, especially warm-blooded anthros. 
Warm-blood carnivores can digest prey in a day or two.

entries.name: digestive aid
entries.content: Pills that aid a predator's digestion. Taking these pills can speed up their digestion and could even allow a pred to digest prey in a single sitting.

entries.name: Anthros
entries.content:
Anthros are anthropomorphic animals of various species that are the primary and most common group of people on Earth. They all have human levels of intelligence and walk bipedally. They are able to speak and write human languages.
The demography amongst anthros is diverse and varied.
Anthro's are usually always 2 feet taller than humans, but depending on the species of anthro, this can go up to 4 to 6 feet, usually elephants, giraffes and dinosaurs being the larger of the anthros. 
Because of their high human diet, anthro's are usually on the plump side, due to how calorically dense humans are.
Anthros are often predators, often preying upon humans in particular, but they'll eat other anthros as well, they don't discriminate on food.
Most anthros believe themselves to be superior to humans and Class E anthros. In their culture, there is a heavy emphasis on survival of the fittest and the circle of life.
All anthros reproduce through internal fertilization, including amphibian and fish anthros.

entries.name: laxatives
entries.content: Laxatives loosen stools and increase bowel movements. They are used to treat and prevent constipation. Laxatives in the anthro state have been made extra-strong for preds; for whenever a pred binges too much and need something to relieve constipation, which is a big issue within the anthro society, as many anthro's do not remove the clothes of prey they consume, leading to their bowels being packed with undigestible clothing.

entries.name: lactation
entries.content:
Female anthros of all species and female humans produce breast milk to feed their young. Milk production usually begins between week 16 and 22 during pregnancy.
Over production of milk can occur for female preds if they digest and absorb prey; digested prey can also enlarge their breasts, leading to better milk production.

entries.name: milk and fertilizer plants
entries.content:
Many cow preds or other female preds may go to Anthro State run dairy and manure farms to get bred every 10 months so they can grow pregnant and produce lots of milk. The farms feed them large helpings of prey daily to increase their milk and manure production.
These facilities are state of the art, giving the female preds comfortable rooms where they can get milked by a machine, watch television, consume prey, relax, and a toilet to excrete their manure that will be bagged up as fertilizer.

entries.name: Humans
entries.content:
Humans are a species of great apes That are characterized by their bipedalism, high intelligence, and lack of fur. In the Anthro State, humans are second class citizens amongst anthros, being given no institutional power of any significance and are viewed as easy prey for preds.
The Anthro State makes sure the human population is plentiful to satisfy all of the hungry predators in the state.
